name: Update store stats

permissions:
  contents: write

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 3 * * 0"   # 일요일 KST 12:00

jobs:
  update-store-stats:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements-store-stats.txt

      - name: Run export script
        env:
          FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_B64: ${{ secrets.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_B64 }}
        run: |
          python scripts/export_store_stats.py

      - name: Commit and push if changed
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          git add store-stats.json
          git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "auto: update store-stats.json $(date +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')"
          git push
